goal: Prevent reporting confirmed transactions as missing when disk reads fail or index corruption occurs
Clearly distinguish I/O errors and pruned blocks from nonexistent transactions in RPC and REST endpoints
agreement: Strong support for separating actual missing transactions from internal read failures (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Objection addressed by preserving block not available errors on pruned blocks (yuvicc)
Approval after clarifying immediate errors on index corruption and adding release notes (enirox001)
Concept approval with full review planned soon (furszy)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because disk read failures and index corruption previously returned false negatives for confirmed transactions
Preserves index integrity and alerts callers early rather than quietly misreporting missing data

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because endpoints now distinguish I/O errors and pruned blocks from actually nonexistent transactions
Fixes misleading error messages and status codes returned to RPC and REST clients
